reviews.text: The modeling mask is quite dry for me… may be not suitable for my skin.
reviews.zh: 呢個 modeling mask 對我嚟講比較乾⋯可能唔太啱我嘅皮膚。

reviews.text: An interesting concept of mask. Initially I wasn’t sure if I’d mixed it together properly but after stirring it it was wearable. Not sure if I’d buy it again solely due to how fast it dries in the pot giving a very small time frame between stirring and application. But it was a very interesting experience.
reviews.zh: 一個幾有趣嘅 mask 概念。一開始我唔肯定有冇溝得夠均勻，但攪拌完之後就可以用。會唔會再買就唔知，因為佢喺碗入面乾得好快，由攪拌到塗上面嘅時間好短。但係一次幾有趣嘅體驗。

reviews.text: Very interesting, not stripping at all, feels very comfortable on the skin and it's easy to peel off. I'm glad I was careful with the measurements upon the first use because I definitely did not need to use the whole portion, it can be split to 2 uses. Planning to rebuy in the future.
reviews.zh: 非常有趣，唔會有繃緊感，貼住皮膚好舒服，而且容易撕走。好在我第一次用嘅時候有小心分量，因為真係唔需要用晒成份，可以分成兩次用。打算將來再回購。

reviews.text: I think i like the green version better. Not sure if i’m doing it wrong but this one always ends up too watery and more difficult to apply
reviews.zh: 我覺得我比較鍾意綠色嗰款。唔知係咪我用得唔啱，但呢款每次都變得太水，比較難塗。

reviews.text:
The mask is really refreshing and cooling the face.
Easy to use.
I recommend not to use all the powder at once- the amount is enough for 3-4 uses (at least to me).

(Please hit like if you find it helpful :) )
reviews.zh:
呢個 mask 真係令到塊面好清爽好涼。容易用。建議唔好一次過用晒成份粉——份量夠用 3-4 次（至少對我嚟講係）。

（如果你覺得有幫助，麻煩俾個 like :)）

reviews.text:
The effects of the mask was good, but it was a bit too liquid for my taste following the lines guides. I liked that the powder was in a sachet as the last time i did a modeling mask, it spreaded everywhere from not being packed. There was a big spatula for mixing and aplication but i think its easier to apply with the hands. 

I didnt really liked the smell, it was a bit the same smell as when you order something and it smells the factory.
reviews.zh: 個 mask 嘅效果係幾好，但照住指示線加水嘅話對我嚟講太稀。我鍾意粉係用小包裝，因為上次我做 modeling mask 嗰陣，因為包裝唔好，粉散到周圍都係。附送咗一支大刮棒攪拌同塗抹，但我覺得用手塗更方便。味道方面我唔太鍾意，有少似網購嘢嗰陣嗰陣工廠味。

reviews.text: I used this mask on top of the serum and it definitely makes a difference in how my skin looks! Overall helps with moisturizing and brightening! Definitely have to work quickly before it dries though
reviews.zh: 我喺精華上面再敷呢個 mask，皮膚望落真係有分別！整體有助保濕同提亮！不過一定要快手喺佢乾之前搞掂。

reviews.text: The mask is great!! The texture is really interesting and it adheres well to your face! It felt cooling and made my skin feel hydrated the next morning!
reviews.zh: 呢個 mask 真係好正！！質地好特別，貼住塊面好貼。敷嘅時候涼浸浸，第二朝皮膚感覺保濕咗！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
